about: Two executor boundaries of a Chopsticks fork of mainnet (spec 1002). The error and runtime_log strings were extracted with a regex from the Chopsticks log files of the runs (~/.cache/forklift, not committed); dev_newBlock was observed in the RPC response

without_allow_unresolved_imports.dev_newBlock: the RPC response was the pin's own hash: no block was built (observed in the response, not in a log)
without_allow_unresolved_imports.consequence: forklift passes --allow-unresolved-imports=true (forklift/chopsticks.py chopsticks_args; UNRESOLVED_IMPORTS records which import each chain needs it for)

tx_pool.rpc: author_submitExtrinsic (a sudo_as Balances.transfer signed by the dev key)
tx_pool.runtime_log: panicked at 'Bad input data provided to validate_transaction: Codec error'
tx_pool.consequence: forklift applies extrinsics on an exact fork through dev_newBlock transactions (forklift/tx.py POOL_BYPASS); the cause of the panic (runtime vs the executor's call encoding) is not isolated
